existing_features.title: Replace the landing page product screenshot carousel images with the 4 uploaded app screenshots (IMG_1297.jpeg, IMG_1298.jpeg, IMG_1299.jpeg, IMG_1300.jpeg), removing all existing carousel images and updating the carousel to support 4 slides (swipe, next/prev, dots).

Redesign the landing page hero section to showcase the 4 uploaded screenshots in a clean, modern device-frame style carousel (or equivalent polished screenshot presentation), replacing the current static hero illustration while keeping the existing hero headline, subheadline, and CTA intact.
Ensure the uploaded screenshots are used only within the landing page hero and/or landing screenshot carousel, and are not added to other app pages.

Update landing-page branding imagery to match the uploaded tree-and-hearts logo inspiration (86096FC5-864D-4BBF-9400-34F371353585-1.JPG): ensure the landing header logo (top-left), any landing thumbnails/brand marks, and footer logo are visually consistent and use the same logo artwork across the landing page.
Update the browser favicon/app icon to match the same landing-page logo artwork/style, and wire it into the static HTML so it appears in the browser tab.

Fix the landing page light/dark mode toggle so that toggling updates the landing page styling immediately and persistently (via the existing ThemeProvider/ThemeContext), including the landing background gradients and card backgrounds.
Store the 4 uploaded screenshot assets in the frontend as static files and reference them directly from landing components (do not route images through the backend).
